info.title: abap-config-mcp Customizing Engine
info.description: The in-system engine of abap-config-mcp (ZCL_MCP_CUST_ENGINE behind SICF node /sap/bc/zmcp_cust): customizing, transports and BW objects through SAP's own APIs, as the calling SAP user. Each call runs as the SAP user the logon maps to; with SAP Cloud Connector principal propagation that is the end user (X.509 certificate mapped in SAP). Writes are dry runs unless commit is true.

post.description: The SAP user, client and system this call runs as, and how it logged on (basic, X.509 client certificate, …). Use it to confirm principal propagation. Reads nothing. Read-only.

200.description: The engine's answer; STATUS says whether it worked

401.description: No SAP logon: missing or unmapped client certificate, or wrong credentials

403.description: The SICF node is inactive, or the SAP user may not call it
